text_en: Then he commanded them to bring her in where his silver dinnerware was kept, and ordered them to set a table for her with some of his own delicacies, and with some of his own wine to drink.
text_cn: 敖罗斐乃令人领她到布满银具的餐厅内，吩咐人给她吃他自己的食品，给她喝他自己的酒。

text_en: But Judith said, “I cannot partake of them, or it will be an offense; but I will have enough with the things I brought with me. ”
text_cn: 但友弟德回答说：“我不愿吃这些东西，怕有什么防碍； 我带来的东西，已足够我吃用的了。”

text_en: Holofernes said to her, “If your supply runs out, where can we get you more of the same? For none of your people are here with us. ”
text_cn: 敖罗斐乃问她说：“假使你带来的东西用完了，从哪里能拿同样的东西来给你呢？我们这里没有你同族的人。”

text_en: Judith replied, “As surely as you live, my lord, your servant will not use up the supplies I have with me before the Lord carries out by my hand what he has determined. ”
text_cn: 友弟德答应他说：“我主万岁！直到上主藉着我的手，完成他所愿意的事以前，我带来的东西，你的婢女是不会用尽的。”

text_en: Then the servants of Holofernes brought her into the tent, and she slept until midnight. Toward the morning watch she got up
text_cn: 以后，敖罗斐乃的仆从领她进入一座帐幕。她睡到半夜，晨更前便起来了，

text_en: and sent this message to Holofernes: “Let my lord now give orders to allow your servant to go out and pray. ”
text_cn: 打发人到敖罗斐乃那里说：“请我主下令，准你的婢女出外祈祷。”

text_en: So Holofernes commanded his guards not to hinder her. She remained in the camp three days. She went out each night to the valley of Bethulia, and bathed at the spring in the camp.
text_cn: 敖罗斐乃就吩咐侍卫，不要阻止她。她在营中住了三天，每夜都出去，往拜突里雅山谷中，哨兵布防的水泉旁沐浴；

text_en: After bathing, she prayed the Lord God of Israel to direct her way for the triumph of his people.
text_cn: 然后上来，哀求上主以色列的天主，指给她一条拯救自己同族子民的正路。

text_en: Then she returned purified and stayed in the tent until she ate her food toward evening.
text_cn: 她取洁回去后，留在帐幕里，直到晚上吃饭的时候。

text_en: On the fourth day Holofernes held a banquet for his personal attendants only, and did not invite any of his officers.
text_cn: 到了第四天，敖罗斐乃设宴，只邀请自己的侍卫，军官中一个也没有邀请。

text_en: He said to Bagoas, the eunuch who had charge of his personal affairs, “Go and persuade the Hebrew woman who is in your care to join us and to eat and drink with us.
text_cn: 他对自己的总管巴哥阿宦官说： “你去劝说住在你旁边的那个希伯来妇女到我们这里来，同我们一起宴饮。

text_en: For it would be a disgrace if we let such a woman go without having intercourse with her. If we do not seduce her, she will laugh at us. ”
text_cn: 如果有这样一个美人在跟前，而不与她交结，这真是扫兴的事！如果我们不引她来，人反会耻笑我们。”

text_en: So Bagoas left the presence of Holofernes, and approached her and said, “Let this pretty girl not hesitate to come to my lord to be honored in his presence, and to enjoy drinking wine with us, and to become today like one of the Assyrian women who serve in the palace of Nebuchadnezzar. ”
text_cn: 巴哥阿离开敖罗斐乃去见她说：“你这美丽的女郎！不要踌躇到我主上那里去，当面受他的尊敬，与我们饮酒取乐。今日你要变作拿步高宫内亚述的公主。”

text_en: Judith replied, “Who am I to refuse my lord? Whatever pleases him I will do at once, and it will be a joy to me until the day of my death. ”
text_cn: 友弟德回答他说：“我是谁，胆敢违背我主上的意思？凡他喜欢的事，我必赶快去作。这是我一生至死最大的喜悦。”

text_en: So she proceeded to dress herself in all her woman’s finery. Her maid went ahead and spread for her on the ground before Holofernes the lambskins she had received from Bagoas for her daily use in reclining.
text_cn: 遂立即前来，穿上锦衣，佩带了妇女所佩带的装饰品；叫她的婢女先去，把巴哥阿给她每日坐着吃饭的皮垫拿去，给友弟德铺在敖罗斐乃对面的地上。

text_en: Then Judith came in and lay down. Holofernes’ heart was ravished with her and his passion was aroused, for he had been waiting for an opportunity to seduce her from the day he first saw her.
text_cn: 友弟德进来，就了位，敖罗斐乃一看她，即心不守舍，神魂颠倒，贪其美色；原来自从见了她那一天起，就想乘机勾引她。

text_en: So Holofernes said to her, “Have a drink and be merry with us! ”
text_cn: 此时敖罗斐乃对她说：“喝罢，大家一同欢乐！”

text_en: Judith said, “I will gladly drink, my lord, because today is the greatest day in my whole life. ”
text_cn: 友弟德说：“是，我主！我愿喝，因为我有生以来，我的生活没有像今天再有价值的了！”

text_en: Then she took what her maid had prepared and ate and drank before him.
text_cn: 就在他面前，将自己婢女预备好的，拿来吃喝。

text_en: Holofernes was greatly pleased with her, and drank a great quantity of wine, much more than he had ever drunk in any one day since he was born.
text_cn: 敖罗斐乃见她如此，喜极狂欢，遂开怀畅饮；有生以来，没有一天，喝过这么多的酒。
